blocks.text: Let's look at this one. x times eight equals eight x. Which property does it show?
Eight x means eight times x. So both sides multiply the same two things, in a different order.
Swapping the order of a multiplication is the commutative property. That's why we can always write the number first.
So the answer is the commutative property.
Watch out for these traps. It isn't the associative property, because there is nothing to regroup. It isn't the distributive property, because there is no sum to spread over.
